interpretation: The uploaded protocol, evaluation rows, report, included completion pins and journals are coherent. New decision count240640 equals the sum of all recorded episode decisions and the counter increase404536→645176.
Training ran successfully. The data establish neither positive nor negative Act1 clear improvement: 47→40 wins/1000, paired gain−0.007 with interval[−0.024,+0.011], exact McNemar p=.499897.

Final policy still reaches the boss stage331/1000 times but clears40 times;291 runs die there. Boss-stage conversion12.1% is very low and does not materially differ descriptively from the initial12.7%. Reaching the boss is also a problem:669 final runs stop earlier.
The declining third-chunk training clear fraction and low overlap of held-out winning seeds are consistent with policy drift, but are insufficient to identify the cause or prove collapse.
There were no training engine failures or timeouts and no final evaluation timeouts. The 12 aborted training rows are four explicit budget-boundary discards perchunk, totaling878 decisions.

This diagnostic bundle contains no SB3 entropy, approximateKL, clipfraction, valueloss or explainedvariance metrics. Previous promises to assess value errors/policy collapse cannot be satisfied conclusively from this bundle alone.
